lines.en: The sand's hot; I'll walk slow.

lines.zh: 我的长腿一步能跨过沙丘。
lines.en: My long legs step over a dune.

lines.zh: 四只宽脚掌，踩不陷进沙里。
lines.en: Four wide feet that never sink.

lines.zh: 顺着风走，鼻子知道方向。
lines.en: I walk with the wind; my nose knows.

lines.zh: 别催，骆驼的步子就是慢。
lines.en: Don't rush me; a camel's pace is slow.
Red sand ahead; let's go there.

lines.zh: 这条沙路我走过很多回。
lines.en: I've walked this sandy road many times.
The village sits behind that dune.
Each step sways my long neck along.
Even after long walks I'm not thirsty.
Sandstone underfoot, hard as anything.
Make room; I'm a big frame.
Sun's west; time to head back.
A line of folk trails behind me.

lines.zh: 沙丘的坡太软，我挑硬的走。
lines.en: The dune slope is soft. I take the firm line.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把长长的影子拖过去。
lines.en: Step by step, I drag my long shadow along.

lines.zh: 站在这儿，晒着太阳就好。
lines.en: Standing here in the sun suits me.
Wind blows sand onto my back.
I chew my cud slowly, unhurried.

lines.zh: 驼峰里存的东西够用很久。
lines.en: What my hump stores lasts a long while.
Desert daylight stretches on forever.
Heat shimmers far off across the flats.
I squint at the flat horizon.
Sand in my ears; I shake it out.

lines.zh: 耐心是骆驼最不缺的东西。
lines.en: Patience is what a camel never lacks.
The sand beneath my hooves still warm.
I'll stand like this all afternoon.

lines.zh: 脖子垂下来，能歇一会儿。
lines.en: Neck drooping, I can rest a while.
A little bug circles my legs.
No need to move before dark.

lines.zh: 有风来，我把耳朵转过去。
lines.en: Wind comes, and I turn an ear to it.

lines.zh: 我看着队伍收拾东西，不催。
lines.en: I watch the caravan pack up. No hurry.
You're a good deal shorter than me.
I lift my head to see your face.
You smell of water, traveler.
Have you come to lead me to the village?

lines.zh: 别站在我正前方，我挡光。
lines.en: Don't stand right in front; I block light.

lines.zh: 我低下头，鼻尖碰了碰你。
lines.en: I lower my head and nudge you.

lines.zh: 你的帽子快被风吹跑了。
lines.en: The wind's about to take your hat.
I know the people on this road.
You stare at me; I stare back.
Touch me if you like; I won't flinch.
Sand in your eyes, I'd guess.
You didn't grow up in the desert.
Ow, that actually hurt.

lines.zh: 我这么大的个子也会痛。
lines.en: Even a big one like me feels pain.
My legs are shaking now.
Stop hitting; I'm backing away.
I grunt and shift aside.
Sand has gotten into the wound.
I snort and turn around.
Who threw that thing at me?
I can still stand upright.
This isn't the pain the desert gives.
Is that cactus? Hand it over.

lines.zh: 闻到一点绿味，我跟着走。
lines.en: I smell something green; I'll follow.

lines.zh: 你手里有吃的，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see you're holding food.

lines.zh: 我这么大个子，吃得也多。
lines.en: A big fellow like me eats plenty.
Hold it higher; I can't reach.

lines.zh: 为了那口仙人掌，走多远都行。
lines.en: For that cactus I'd walk any distance.
You've hidden it behind your back.
I follow you for this one bite.
Not so fast; long legs, but lazy.
This smells far better than dry grass.

lines.zh: 我鼻子一抽就知道是好东西。
lines.en: One sniff tells me it's a good thing.
Hold your hand flat; I'll take it gently.
It's covered in spines. I don't mind.
I'll follow you past that far dune.
That bundle in your hand. I know it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢低头，不抢你的手。
lines.en: I lower my head slowly. I will not bite your hand.
You bumped me; I'm not small.
Step aside; I need room to turn.

lines.zh: 我的腿太长，容易绊到你。
lines.en: My legs are long and trip you easily.
Don't shove; I carry real weight.
I didn't see you when I lifted my foot.

lines.zh: 这窄道容不下我们两个。
lines.en: This narrow path can't hold us both.
I'll shift back a little now.
You bumped into my flank.

lines.zh: 沙漠里路宽，别挨这么近。
lines.en: The desert's wide; don't crowd me.
Steady yourself; I sway when I move.
Two camels standing side by side.
I wrap my neck around you.
It's quiet behind the dune; come with me.
We'll walk slowly; there's no hurry.
You like this red sand too, don't you.

lines.zh: 两头骆驼的影子叠在一起。
lines.en: Our two shadows overlap on the sand.

lines.zh: 我低低叫一声，你听见了吗？
lines.en: I rumble low; did you hear it?
Let's lie down in the sand together.

lines.zh: 明年沙丘边会有小骆驼。
lines.en: Next year a calf will stand by the dune.
Don't wander; stay near here.
Something's on the ground; I'll take it.
Dropped in the sand, so it's mine.
I've got it between my lips.

lines.zh: 是谁把东西落在沙丘上？
lines.en: Who left this out on the dune?
Not edible, but useful enough.

lines.zh: 我低头翻找沙里的东西。
lines.en: I lower my head to sift the sand.
Whatever fell is covered in sand.
I've set it up on my back.

lines.zh: 驼队掉了东西，我捡回来。
lines.en: The caravan dropped this; I'll bring it back.
What's that glinting in the sand?
I smell that thing coming closer.
You're in my way; I don't like it.
Something's moving under the sand.
I lower my head, ready to push.
Who touched my leg just now?
That shadow isn't mine.
I'll stand in front of the group.
Something's digging in my sand.
It's after my cactus.
I've got my eye on that shape.
I close in one step at a time.
Slow doesn't mean I can't catch you.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子已经抬起来了。
lines.en: My hoof is already raised.
Care to feel how heavy I am?
I snort a warning at you.
Sand scatters beneath my feet.
Back off; I'm about to charge.
I keep my eyes fixed on you.
This camel is not pleased.

lines.zh: 我压低脖子，慢慢转过来。
lines.en: I lower my neck and turn slowly.
I butt you with my head.
My front hoof comes down.
I kick out with a long leg.
One hit and you'll know my weight.
I knock you back a few steps.
My hoofprints fill the dust.
Don't pull at my reins.
I shoulder you off to the side.
That blow was only a warning.
I'm still panting, and not finished.
I rise up out of the hot sand.
The sun just reached this dune.
The sand gives way; I find footing.
Born here, raised here.
The wind blows the sand off me.
I can see the village far off.

lines.zh: 红沙上留下第一个脚印。
lines.en: First footprint left on the red sand.
This spot is wide enough for me.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖刚沾上的沙子。
lines.en: I shake off the fresh sand.
The dune's shadow covers me.
Fire! My coat is burning.
I tumbled all the way down the dune.
Too deep; I can't swim.
Sand blown sky-high by the blast.
Something struck my flank.
Strange; like wind blown through me.
Empty belly; my hump has gone flat.
Lightning struck my back.
No sand below, only emptiness.
